description: Owner-only: read the original SQL ZIP export's progress and error only. It never returns a download URL: archive.download_url and download_expires_at are always null here. Follow next_poll_after_seconds while queued/running; never create another export to poll. When state is succeeded, call project_export_download_link_create with the same project_id and export_id for the signed 24-hour ZIP link. The password cannot be retrieved. Available at zero credits.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: project_export_get
